sections.title: Scenario
sections.prompt: Who is the user, what is the job, and which numbers shape the design?
criteria: States the user and the job in one sentence
Derives the month-end peak (documents per day or hour) from the 40% in 5 days
Names straight-through rate with a target, paired with an accuracy guard on posted bills
Lists at least one thing explicitly out of scope, such as making payments

sections.title: Single View
sections.prompt: Draw the pipeline as layers: what runs in each, what it hands to the next, and why it exists.
criteria: Has separate layers for intake, OCR, extraction, validation, posting and review
Puts a queue between intake and processing
States one idea that separates what the model extracts from what code decides to post

sections.title: Data Sources
sections.prompt: Where do documents come from, which systems are checked against, and how fresh must each be?
criteria: Covers both the mailbox and portal channels and how they overlap
Reads POs and receipts live at validation time, not from a stale copy
Has a backstop for missed mail notifications (sweep, poll or subscription renewal)

sections.title: Processing
sections.prompt: How does a raw file become typed documents with text and coordinates?
criteria: Splits multi-document PDFs and classifies each document type
Uses OCR that returns word coordinates and confidences
Has a path for low-quality scans or photos with a stated trigger
Handles non-PDF formats or rejects them to review

sections.title: Agents
sections.prompt: Is this an agent or a pipeline, and where, if anywhere, does the model get to act?
criteria: Uses a fixed state machine with named states
Gives the extraction call no tools and a strict output schema
Requires human approval for any outbound message the model drafts

sections.title: Memory
sections.prompt: What does the system learn and keep between documents, and where?
criteria: Keeps per-vendor knowledge (format hints or examples) in a named store
Stores reviewer corrections field by field
Keeps vendor-master changes out of the automatic learning loop

sections.title: MCP Tool Servers
sections.prompt: What ERP operations are exposed, with what permissions and guards?
criteria: Lists lookup and posting tools with read or write noted
Makes posting idempotent (externalId or idempotency key)
Re-checks money rules inside the posting tool
Uses an ERP role that cannot edit vendors or create payments

sections.title: Endpoints
sections.prompt: What is the API surface, and how long does one document take end to end?
criteria: Gives a per-stage processing time whose total fits the 15-minute SLA
Estimates documents in flight or worker count at peak
Acknowledges webhooks fast and processes asynchronously
Uses queue age as the alerting signal

sections.title: Caching
sections.prompt: What do you cache, what do you never cache, and what does a document cost?
criteria: Shows per-document and monthly cost covering OCR and LLM tokens
Shows the effect of prompt caching or batch pricing
Caches OCR output by content hash
States that duplicate checks and receipts are never cached

sections.title: Data Stores
sections.prompt: Which stores hold what, how big are they, and how is posting kept consistent?
criteria: Sizes document storage including 7-year retention
Stores field values with their evidence (page or OCR line)
Has a unique key on vendor plus normalized invoice number
Uses an outbox or equivalent so ledger and ERP post cannot diverge

sections.title: Output
sections.prompt: What does each document end as, and what does a reviewer see?
criteria: Defines final states (posted, in review, rejected) with typed outputs
Gives review items specific reason codes
Validates extraction output against a schema with a bounded retry

sections.title: Guardrails
sections.prompt: What stops a wrong, duplicate or fraudulent invoice from being posted?
criteria: Enforces the $25,000 cap and three-way match tolerance in code
Holds any bank-detail mismatch and verifies out of band
Derives field confidence from evidence rather than the model's self-report
Keeps taxpayer ids away from the model and out of logs

sections.title: Key Impact
sections.prompt: What business numbers move, and how are they measured?
criteria: Gives baseline and target for straight-through rate
Audits accuracy on posted bills with a stated sample size
Runs a shadow period before auto-posting
Translates the result into hours or dollars

sections.title: Failure Modes
sections.prompt: What breaks, and what catches each failure?
criteria: Covers an ERP timeout with an idempotent retry
Covers OCR throttling or a model outage at month-end
Covers a vendor layout change with per-vendor accuracy monitoring
Has a dead-letter path for poison documents

sections.title: Build Order
sections.prompt: In what order do you build it, and what number unlocks each step?
criteria: Builds the golden set first
Ends each step with a measurable number
Starts auto-posting with a lower cap or a subset of vendors, then widens
